triggers._pattern_note: Patterns are REGEX (re.compile, no auto-escape), so the brackets MUST be escaped. Unescaped, '[[ WARNING ...]]' parses as a character class + a literal ']' and matches ANY line with a common letter or space before a ']' - '[Notice]', '[chat]', '[Newbie]' all fired 'tactical'.
